title: Fiduciary Duty Disclosure
description: Requires advisors to disclose all material conflicts of interest, including compensation received for recommending specific products.

title: Fee and Expense Disclosure
description: Requires clear and prominent disclosure of all fees, expenses, and charges associated with a recommended product. This applies to all advisory accounts regardless of size.

title: Risk Factor Disclosure
description: Requires clear disclosure of principal risks of loss associated with an investment, including that past performance does not guarantee future results. This applies to all advisory accounts regardless of size.
